name.km: សម្លម្ជូរត្រកួនក្ដាម
name.en: Sour Soup with Morning Glory & Crab

description: A bright Khmer sour soup of morning glory with crab.
descriptionKm: សម្លម្ជូរស្រស់ ផ្សំជាមួយត្រកួន និងក្ដាម។
equipmentKm: ឆ្នាំងស៊ុប

ingredients.notesKm: សម្អាត ហើយកាត់ជា ៤

ingredients.itemKm: ទឹកស៊ុប ឬ ទឹក
ជីអង្ការ និងម្អម

ingredients.notesKm: សម្រាប់បរិភោគ

instructions.text: Bring the stock to a boil with bruised lemongrass and smashed garlic.
instructions.textKm: ដាំទឹកស៊ុបជាមួយស្លឹកគ្រៃបុក និងខ្ទឹមសបុក។

instructions.text: Add the crab (cleaned and quartered) and simmer until almost cooked.
Add the morning glory and simmer until tender.
Season with tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar; balance to a clean sour-salty-sweet.
instructions.tip: Add tamarind gradually and taste — sourness should brighten, not dominate.

instructions.text: Finish with sawtooth coriander and rice-paddy herb; serve with rice.
